title: Atomic Chat Recommended Models
description: Schema for the remote recommended-models manifest consumed by the Atomic Chat (Jan) client.

schema_version.description: Bump this when the shape of a recommendation entry changes in a backwards-incompatible way.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; refresh on every meaningful change.

low_spec_recommendations.description: Superseded by `tiers`, which covers the same ground with eleven rungs instead of two. Kept because clients shipped before `tiers` existed read this and nothing else: it replaces (does not extend) `recommendations` on machines they classify as low-spec — Apple Silicon under 16 GB unified memory, or under 8 GB VRAM elsewhere.

tiers.description: The one model to offer, per hardware tier (ATO-463). The client picks the tier from the memory pool the weights actually load into: `cpu_only` when no accelerator is enumerated, `vram_*` from the largest single card (bucket upper bound in GiB), `unified_*` from unified memory on Apple Silicon and ARM hosts. Index 0 of each list is what the first-run screen leads with; anything after it goes under "other options". A tier the manifest omits falls back to the client's bundled ladder, so a partial object is valid. Clients built before this key existed ignore it and keep reading `recommendations` / `low_spec_recommendations` — do NOT bump schema_version for this key.

description_key.description: i18n key for the chip label. Must start with 'hub:' and exist in web-app/src/locales/*/hub.json.

quant.description: Pins which quant to download, matched against the quant token parsed from the GGUF filename (e.g. "Q8_0", "Q4_K_M"). Omit to let the client pick its house default.

mmproj_quant.description: Vision models only: pins the multimodal projector quant. Omit to let the client pick.

platforms.description: If omitted, the recommendation is shown on every platform.

active.description: Set to false to hide a recommendation without removing the entry.
